rules.description: All top-level route components must be lazy-loaded via React.lazy() or Next.js dynamic()
Lazy routes must be wrapped in <Suspense fallback={<LoadingFallback/>}>
A catch-all route (path='*') or 404 page must be defined
Router must have an error boundary (errorElement in React Router, or ErrorBoundary wrap)
All :param segments in route paths must have corresponding TypeScript type definitions
Redirect chains must not form cycles
Routes marked as protected must use a ProtectedRoute/RequireAuth wrapper
